options.title: Sikkim ka apna raja tha? Phir yeh India ka state kaise bana? 👑
options.first_line: सिक्किम का कभी अपना राजा था। फिर ये भारत का स्टेट कैसे बना?
options.first_frame: Sikkim lit red and gold between Nepal and Bhutan on India's map, its old kingdom flag already waving on it and a small crown bobbing over Gangtok

options.title: Ek vote ne Sikkim ko India ka state kaise banaya? 🗳️
options.first_line: सिक्किम को भारत का स्टेट एक वोट ने बनाया। कैसे?
options.first_frame: Sikkim lit on the map with a wooden ballot box dropping onto it, the rest of India pale

options.title: Nepal aur Bhutan ke beech yeh chhota sa desh kahan gaya? 🗺️
options.first_line: नेपाल और भूटान के बीच का ये छोटा सा देश कहाँ गया?
options.first_frame: Nepal and Bhutan in their colours with the small gap between them glowing gold, a question tag over it

why: A famous, picturable state plus the surprise that it once had its own king raises a real "how is that possible?" that only the video answers, and the crown and kingdom flag on Sikkim say it without sound; B already gives away the vote and C holds the subject back.
